Name: Kenneth's Lofi Farm Beats
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Lofi Farm Beats[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A pack of 18 lofi tracks for the Mini-Jukebox. Made this for those chill moments on the farm, coffee, rainy days, just relaxing.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Includes:[/b][/size]
[b][size=4]Cabin[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]Chill[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Chiptune[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Coffee[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Cozy[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Daydream[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Drive[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Garden[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Midnight[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Night[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Pixel[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Rainy[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Serenity[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Stroll[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Sunset[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Underwater[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Vibe[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Zen[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All tracks are added to the Mini-Jukebox and ready to play.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements: SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Install: Drop the folder into Mods.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]It only adds new music, no replacements, and works fine with existing saves.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: All of my music mods are separate packs but fully compatible. You can install just one or all of them at the same time with no conflicts.[/b][/size]
